set.body: Goal: first human inspection of rendered output. Render every RendererConformance case plus a solved DesignGraphics event plot and a derived-guides scatter (legend, log10 axis) to SVG files / an HTML gallery and review visually. Acceptance: gallery generated reproducibly (script or test-tagged main); reviewer signs off or files concrete polish issues (spacing, default sizes, tick/label offsets, legend metrics) tagged graphics-polish; any semantic surprise (orientation, anchoring, clipping) becomes a p1 bug with a failing test before fix. This is the acceptance test of the estimator-tuned layout defaults.
set.title: Graphics: visual gallery smoke check and polish list
